newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway to announce Barents licences on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Norway to announce Barents licences on Thursday.

text.p: Norway's Oil and Energy Ministry said on Wednesday it will announce licence awards for the Barents Sea region on Thursday.
Under the so-called Barents Sea Project, authorities announced in October that around 45 blocks in the area were candidates for licence awards.

According to the most recent figures from the Norwegian Oil Directorate (OD) the Barents region is believed to hold around 24 percent of undiscovered resources on the Norwegian continental shelf, which are thought to amount to some 3.5 billion cubic metres of oil equivalent.
Since 1980 a total of 35 production licences have been awarded in the Barents Sea, resulting in several minor and medium-sized gas structure discoveries.
Water depths and difficult seabed conditions as well as the need for possible onshore terminals means the area will require large investments to develop.
